name: MSeg
description: MSeg is a composite dataset that unifies semantic segmentation datasets from different domains by reconciling taxonomies and aligning pixel-level annotations. It enables training a single semantic segmentation model that generalizes across domains and unseen datasets, evaluated via zero-shot cross-dataset transfer.
reputation: A respected cross-dataset semantic segmentation benchmark used to study taxonomy alignment and zero-shot transfer across diverse vision datasets.
notes: Relabeled over 220,000 object masks in 80,000+ images; enables robust cross-dataset generalization; evaluated on WildDash-v1 leaderboard and Robust Vision Challenge.
